title: Ongiini-Eval-OW model submission line
description: Schema for one line of a model-submission JSONL file. Each line represents one (item, dialect, model) triple — the model's translation of one English source item into one of the two Oshiwambo dialects. See the submission README and the concept paper for the surrounding protocol.

id.description: Eval-set item ID. Matches the `id` column in eval_set.tsv and the line number in en.txt (1-indexed).

dialect.description: Target dialect of this translation. Submissions are one JSONL file per (model × dialect).

model_id.description: Stable model identifier. Recommended format: `<vendor>/<model-name>[:version]`. Used as the leaderboard row key and as the directory name (with `/` replaced by `--` in paths).

prompt_template_id.description: Identifier for the prompt template used. The default is `ongiini-eval-ow-v1-zeroshot` (see Appendix C of the concept paper). If you used a different template, document it in the model card.

translation.description: The model's translation in the target dialect. Empty string is allowed (some MT systems will not produce output for an unsupported language); English pass-through is allowed. Both are recorded as-is and visible on the leaderboard.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the inference call.

model_version.description: Optional vendor build / checkpoint identifier (e.g. a model-card date stamp, a Hugging Face revision hash).

inference_compute.description: Optional free-form metadata about the inference call (hardware, latency).

seed.description: Optional random seed used during decoding, where applicable.

raw_response.description: Optional: the model's full response before any post-processing. Useful when you applied trimming, prefix-stripping, or formatting that might affect comparability.
